acceptance: aipo run executes the MVP language subset end-to-end through source -> lexer -> parser -> HIR -> sema -> Core IR -> bytecode -> VM: functions with real locals and parameters, default parameters evaluated per call (including defaults referencing earlier parameters), named arguments in any order, closures with upvalues and per-iteration capture in loops

List and Dict core methods are bound to the VM and dispatched by the receiver, including the higher-order transform, filter and sort_by, which invoke the Aipo callable through the VM so closures, failures and faults behave as at any other call site

Ranges a..b, list/string/Bytes slicing with negative and omitted bounds, first-class Byte/Bytes/type values (Value::Byte, Value::Bytes, Value::Type over a TypeTag), and the inconditional runtime fault AIPO_RT_MUTATION_DURING_ITERATION are implemented and exercised by the conformance corpus

import/export execute with a deterministic topological initialization order, init-once semantics under repeated import, privacy enforced by name resolution, and AIPO_SEM_IMPORT_CYCLE / AIPO_SEM_UNKNOWN_MODULE reported as diagnostics rather than runtime faults

docs/stdlib/mvp-subset.md documents the implemented surface (including the List/Dict methods), docs/adp/ADP-001 records the resolution of Q1 (Byte runtime kind) and Q2 (first-class type values) while leaving Q3-Q5 open, and docs/evidence/P00-G10-backend-completion.md attaches the gate output
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, cargo test --workspace and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
